name: Double drop
lesson:
## Two drops on the same beat

Cue B so its drop lands on bar 17 of A's drop section. B waits silent, then its fader slams up in the quarter beat before bar 17 so both drops hit together; A leaves over bars 21 to 25. Key-match the two tracks or the moment collapses.

The prep is the skill: you need both tracks' drop points as hot cues before you begin.
